module: Auxiliary controller simulating an air transfer valve between two tanks (energyStorage): air passes from the source tank to the target tank as long as the source pressure exceeds a minimum and that of the target. The flow depends on the valve cross-section and the pressure difference (orifice equation).
notes: jbeam keys read in init: sourceTankName ("mainAirTank"), targetTankName ("auxAirTank"), flowPipeRadius (0.0075 m), flowValveRadius (0.2 x flowPipeRadius), sourceTankMinPressure (Pa, 0) or sourceTankMinPressurePSI (converted to absolute Pa: psi x 6894.757 + 101325), pressureDiffForFullFlow (34473.8 Pa = 5 psi) or pressureDiffForFullFlowPSI (difference, without atmospheric pressure).
If one of the two tanks is not found, a D log is written and updateFixedStep is replaced by nop (the valve does nothing).
The transfer is one-way source -> target.

init.desc: Gets the source/target tanks and computes the cross-sections and pressure thresholds from the jbeam keys.

updateFixedStep.desc: Physics step: computes the air flow between the tanks and transfers the stored energy from the source to the target, updating currentPressure of both.
